text: Optical Axis: Ger. Augenaxe ; Fr. axe de l'oeil ; Ital. asse oculare . A straight line drawn through the centre of curvature of cornea and lens, and prolonged to the posterior wall of the eye. It is the sagittal axis mentioned under CENTRE OF ROTATION (q.v.). Literature : HELMHOLTZ, Physiol. Optik (2nd ed.), 5, 88, 108; WALLER, Human Physiol., 412. ( E.B.T. )
